For TMCs & Operators

Give agents one search for every supplier.

The Agent Booking Tool is a professional booking cockpit for TMC teams. One screen connects to Amadeus, Sabre, Travelport, OTA supply, direct hotel rates, policy rules, payment status, and reporting through G-Link and F-Link.

See the cockpit How it works
Agent Cockpit

One interface. Every booking workflow.

Agents switch between too many tools per booking. The Agent Booking Tool brings search, quoting, booking, and reporting into one surface designed for real TMC workflows.

Unified Search

Every supplier. One query.

Connect to Amadeus, Sabre, Travelport, OTA aggregators, and direct hotel supply simultaneously. Negotiated rates from AgreeEase surface automatically with clear rate breakdowns, cancellation terms, and availability confidence. No more tabbing between GDS terminals and rate sheets.

See how search works
Quote Builder

From search results to branded PDF in minutes.

Select multiple options across flight, hotel, and ground. Build comparison quotes with your TMC branding. Send to clients directly. No copy-pasting between systems, no formatting spreadsheets at midnight.

See quoting workflow
Booking Management

Book on behalf. Full audit trail.

Complete bookings for any traveler with role-based access. Every action logged. Every change tracked. Programme rates enforced at point of booking so agents never accidentally book outside policy.

See booking flow
Data & Analytics

Booking data that drives better negotiations.

Every search, quote, and booking generates structured data. See which suppliers win, where negotiated rates are used, where leakage happens, and which response patterns slow agents down. Turn booking volume into leverage at the next rate review.

See analytics
Platform Capabilities

Built for agents, not adapted from consumers.

Most booking tools started as consumer products. The Agent Booking Tool was designed around professional TMC workflows: supplier comparison, quote building, payment visibility, audit trails, and client-ready reporting.

•

Multi-GDS search in a single interface

Core

Connect to Amadeus, Sabre, and Travelport simultaneously. Add OTA and direct hotel supply through G-Link. Agents see every available option in one ranked view with supplier source, rate rules, availability confidence, cancellation terms, and policy status visible before quote or booking.

•

Standalone or embedded

Deploy

Run as your primary booking tool or embed within existing OBT systems. No rip-and-replace required.

•

New agents productive in days

UX

Simplified rate comparison and guided workflows mean new hires are booking confidently within days, not the weeks legacy GDS training requires.

•

Programme rate enforcement

Rates

Negotiated rates from AgreeEase and G-Link surface automatically at point of search. Agents always see preferred pricing before open-market alternatives.

•

Multi-language and currency support

Global

Support regional TMC operations across APAC with localized interfaces, multi-currency display, and market-specific supplier content. One deployment covers Singapore, Hong Kong, Japan, and beyond.

The Agent Advantage

Your agents handle the relationships. The tool handles the searching.

Six disconnected tools per booking is not a workflow. It is a margin problem. Every screen switch costs time, every manual rate check risks error, and every hand-keyed report delays delivery. The Agent Booking Tool removes the friction so agents can focus on what TMCs are built for: service quality and client relationships.

Open architecture

You keep your GDS agreements, your supplier relationships, and your commercial terms. The tool connects to your infrastructure. It does not replace it.

Layer, don't replace

Deploy alongside your existing tools. Start with hotel search. Add flights when ready. Expand to full booking when the team is confident. No big-bang migration.

Regional scale

One agreement with a regional TMC HQ in Singapore can deploy across multiple APAC markets simultaneously. Built for how regional networks actually operate.

Why TMCs Switch

The margin problem is a tools problem.

Every booking that touches six screens, three rate sheets, and a manual report costs more than it should. The Agent Booking Tool compresses the workflow and protects margin.

Simplified rate comparison

GDS rates, OTA rates, and negotiated programme rates displayed side by side. Agents compare instantly instead of checking each source manually.

Duty of care visibility

Real-time traveler location data connected to booking records. When disruption hits, you know where your travelers are without chasing PNRs across systems.

Automated reporting

Booking data, payment status, supplier performance, and service history flow directly into reports. No manual extraction, no late delivery, no formatting errors. Clients get what they need when they need it.

Win more pitches

Demonstrate modern booking technology in client presentations. Show the same search-to-quote speed that digitally-native competitors promise, backed by the service depth only a real TMC delivers.
